response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n_sites * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.rate > o.overall

assumptions.assumption: A status's rate is the average of per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios. Scans with a NULL gbsize or spanmin are ignored, and a spanmin of 0 is treated as missing to avoid division errors.
The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates. Statuses whose rate is NULL are excluded from it. A NULL healtheval, if present, counts as its own status group.
Distinct sites per status are counted from the scans that match a site.

alternatives.interpretation: A status's rate is the ratio of aggregates, SUM(gbsize)/SUM(spanmin), over scans where both values are present, rather than the average of per-scan ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n_sites * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.rate > o.overall
